notes: All three settings screens are complete, legible 1366x768 viewports with a consistent shell and fictional demo data. Only minor presentation inconsistencies were found, notably duplicated unit suffixes on SET-004.

screens.summary: Complete, legible notification settings screen with consistent shell, cards and controls; no patient data is exposed.
Complete security settings screen with clear hierarchy and consistent styling. Minor note: its save action sits below the card instead of in the top-right header used by sibling screens.

issues.observation: The primary save button is centered below the card, while sibling settings screens place save actions in the top-right page header.

screens.summary: Complete clinic and safety form with consistent layout and controls. Two numeric fields duplicate their unit suffixes, showing '10 doses doses' and '30 days days'.

issues.observation: Low-stock threshold shows '10 doses' plus a second 'doses' suffix, and expiry warning shows '30 days' plus a second 'days' suffix.
